Very positively surprised with that tool. It worked perfectly on the heavy duty high resistance springs of our Fiat Ducato. Very strong, and well built, it felt pretty safe to use it even without a cage. Excellent ratio price/quality!

Bought for use on a set of truck struts and they worked great! Compressing vehicle springs is a scary process but between the effective locking mechanism and the smooth operation, these worked very well. For comparison, I also have a scissor-type spring compressor and that is more bulky, cumbersome, and difficult to use than these. I did grease the full length of the internal screws and telescoping/sliding tubes before use but they probably would have worked alright if I hadn't-I did it more for longevity.
